analysis: Docs-only PR: docs/developer/test.md (head lines 487-505) adds a 'Nemotron Super component qualification' section about portable fixture harnesses, a committed prompt golden corpus and image goldens. docs/provider/direct-mode.md (patch hunk @@ -173, head ~176-211) adds an 'Experimental Nemotron Super owner fixtures' section describing an optional NemotronSuperLocalImageHTTP hook. The hook is described as absent by default, with no production callsite installing it and no new model advertised. It reuses the existing local authentication, body limits and cancellation scope, serves inline PNG/JPEG data URIs selected by content, and returns 429 beyond a concurrency of 1 (tunable via DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MAX_CONCURRENT) and 400 for unsupported controls. No source code, protocol, attestation or authorization files changed, so TB-002 and TB-011 and threats T-050 and T-053..T-058 are unaffected. The doc text itself does not claim production qualification and explicitly disclaims full image support. The Swift source for the hook (NemotronSuperLocalImageHTTP.swift) and the image decoder are not in this batch. Any decoder or media temp-file handling there (compare T-050 on inline video plaintext in temp files) and the claims of local auth reuse, bounded decoding and cancellation retention need review in the source-bearing PR or batch. The direct-mode patch excerpt is truncated after the 429 row, but the unit text is complete through the final paragraph. No concrete security regression is visible from the docs alone.
